name: openpixo/pixel-16-bit
title: Retro pixel · 16-bit
description: Classic 16-bit console pixel art: crisp, richly shaded sprites, props and tiles that stay easy to read.

description_i18n.en: Classic 16-bit console pixel art: crisp, richly shaded sprites, props and tiles that stay easy to read.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 经典 16 位主机的像素画：像素边缘清晰、明暗层次丰富，角色、道具和地块都一眼看得清。

examples.title: Knight sprite
examples.prompt: Generate a single 32x32 knight idle sprite using the pixel-16-bit art style, with an iron helmet, teal cloak and a readable wooden shield. Export a transparent PNG at native size and a nearest-neighbor enlarged preview.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 pixel-16-bit 美术风格生成一张 32x32 骑士待机精灵：铁盔、青绿色披风、轮廓清晰的木盾。导出原生尺寸透明 PNG 和最近邻放大的预览图。

examples.title: Forest pickups
examples.prompt: Create six matching forest pickup icons using the pixel-16-bit art style: acorn, herb, amber shard, wooden key, mushroom and small potion. Keep one consistent pixel scale and light direction.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 pixel-16-bit 美术风格制作六枚配套的森林拾取物图标：橡果、草药、琥珀碎片、木钥匙、蘑菇和小药水。保持统一像素尺度和光照方向。

style.prompt: 16-bit game pixel art with deliberate square-pixel clusters, a compact shared palette, three-step material shading and crisp stair-step contours. Clear silhouettes, restrained dithering only in broad shadow transitions, consistent upper-left light and a stable three-quarter view. Keep highlights and details readable at native sprite scale; use nearest-neighbor scaling.
style.negativePrompt: photorealism, smooth vector curves, subpixel detail, anti-aliased edges, painterly brushwork, gradients between individual pixels, noisy dithering, mixed pixel scales, blurry pixels, text, watermark

constraints.outline: One native-pixel dark contour; selective lighter edges on lit surfaces.
